attribution: Separate user statements, assistant output, tool output, third-party quotations, user reports and interpretations.
evidence: Cite target messages; context alone cannot justify target labels.
branches: Follow parent links and keep alternative children separate.
overlap: Repeated context is not an independent observation; deduplicate observations by target node/span.
retention: No source key deletion is authorized by this pilot; unresolved retain/omit decisions remain open.
outcomes: Drafts, answers and intentions do not prove execution or real-world outcomes.
scores: NMF weights are retrieval signals, not confidence or calibrated probabilities.
